title: Vacant-Home Visit Calendar for In-Place Home Resale Homes: Freeze and Storm Seasons
content:
**Property services visit calendar.** Where an In-Place Home Resale package charges for the vacant-home check, the visit frequency of a month's check turns the check subtotal into the visit charge. The visit frequency follows the community on the seller's Home-Site Lease and the month charged:

- at Cedar Hollow or Conestoga Meadows, in a month that is one of the package's winterization months (November, December, January, February and March on every package), the home is checked weekly and the visit charge is the check subtotal multiplied by 2.0;
- at Willow Bend Estates or Palmetto Shores, in a month that is one of the storm months — June, July, August, September, October and November (months 6 to 11) — the home keeps its monthly visit and is also walked after named storms, so the visit charge is the check subtotal plus 30.00;
- in any other community or month, the visit charge is the check subtotal itself.

The *check subtotal* is the package's monthly vacant-home check fee together with the additions the month's check carries for the home, added together. The community is the one the seller's Home-Site Lease places the home in.

| Community on the Home-Site Lease | Month charged | Visit charge |
|---|---|---|
| Cedar Hollow or Conestoga Meadows | November to March | check subtotal multiplied by 2.0 |
| Cedar Hollow or Conestoga Meadows | April to October | check subtotal |
| Willow Bend Estates or Palmetto Shores | June to November | check subtotal plus 30.00 |
| Willow Bend Estates or Palmetto Shores | December to May | check subtotal |
| Saguaro Vista or Bluebonnet Ridge | any month | check subtotal |

## Worked figures (hypothetical check subtotal of 70.00)

| Home | Month | Visit charge |
|---|---|---|
| Conestoga Meadows | January | 70.00 multiplied by 2.0, 140.00 |
| Cedar Hollow | April | 70.00 |
| Palmetto Shores | November | 70.00 plus 30.00, 100.00 |
| Willow Bend Estates | December | 70.00 |
| Bluebonnet Ridge | August | 70.00 |
